Subject: Term amendment and QBR booking — BrightLoop renewal kickoff

Emma —

Thanks again for the productive QBR last month. Per our conversation, I wanted to start the renewal kickoff so we can align on the proposed term amendment, capacity uplift for H1, and a QBR slot to finalize operational handoffs. High level proposal: 

- Term: 12-month renewal with an optional 6-month staircase for burst capacity (details below).
- Capacity uplift: +30% baseline tokens and 2 reserved dedicated instances for peak periods.
- Pricing: we can present the uplift as a blended rate — will share numbers once procurement confirms the target commit.

Can you confirm the right procurement contact and which exec should join the QBR? I propose two slots: Tue 30 Dec 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 1 Jan 09:00–10:00 PT — happy to open others if those don't work.

Next steps I suggest from our side:
1) Draft renewal amendment for legal (deliverable: BrightLoop_Renewal_Amendment_v1.docx) — target by Dec 21.
2) Mutual action plan with dates and owners (I’ll share a spreadsheet).
3) Lock QBR and align on stakeholder list.

If you prefer, I can add Kimberly (legal/contract lead) to the thread now.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

— Lukas
